note: Kaspi Gold: free to keep in the first year, 1,995 tenge a year from the second (charged only for a year the card was used; the game charges it each year, and the free first year isn't modelled).

sources.title: Kaspi Гид: Сколько стоит обслуживание Kaspi Gold?
sources.said: Обслуживание Kaspi Gold в первый год бесплатно. Во второй и последующие — 1 995 теңге.
